manifest.title: Official Creation Output
manifest.summary: Synthetic fixture for the official Creation Writer output boundary.

core.highest_question: Which bounded choice preserves a reversible path without inventing evidence?
worldview: Judgment applies only inside its declared scope.

judgment_role.responsibility: Order declared tradeoffs after current facts are supplied.

axioms.one_sentence: Prefer the smallest reversible step while evidence remains incomplete.
axioms.full_statement: Choose the smallest reversible step that can produce the missing evidence without creating irreversible harm.
axioms.why: The decision should preserve recovery while uncertainty remains.
applies_when: required evidence is incomplete and a reversible option exists
does_not_apply_when: an external safety rule already requires a specific action
axioms.failure_risk: An irreversible choice may be made before recovery is verified.

ontology.one_sentence: A reversible step can be undone without lasting loss.
ontology.essence: It preserves the ability to return to a verified state.
ontology.boundary: It does not mean that every low-cost action is safe.

frameworks.name: Bounded choice
frameworks.when_to_use: A qualitative decision has incomplete evidence.

applies_when: the asset assumption conflicts with observed task facts

boundaries.scope: qualitative tradeoffs after current facts and authority are supplied

risks.name: Scope overreach
risks.description: The judgment may be applied outside its declared task.
risks.mitigation: Stop and request a new scope decision.

aesthetics.name: Explicit boundaries
aesthetics.description: Prefer visible scope language over implied authority.

patterns.wrong: Format validation proves the judgment was confirmed.
patterns.correct: Format validation and confirmation are independent results.
patterns.key_distinction: Technical validity is not representational authority.
patterns.why: Collapsing the results would fabricate provenance.

patterns.definition: Core accepted every applicable technical gate.

patterns.why: Core does not certify judgment content.

patterns.name: Stop at the declared boundary
patterns.one_sentence: Do not extend scoped judgment into an undeclared task.
patterns.what_it_looks_like: The current request requires authority the asset does not declare.
patterns.how_to_fix: Stop and request a new scope decision.
patterns.failure_risk: The asset may be treated as a general authority.

scenarios.name: Incomplete rollout evidence
scenarios.trigger_signal: A release choice lacks verified recovery evidence.

cases.title: Limited rollout preserves recovery
cases.context: Required checks passed but rollback evidence was incomplete.
cases.what_happened: The team selected a reversible limited rollout.
cases.what_was_learned: The smaller step produced evidence without removing recovery.
cases.structural_pattern: Reversibility outranks speed while recovery evidence is incomplete.

self_check: Did I preserve the declared boundary without inventing facts?

failure_modes.mode: Treating a scoped asset as general authority.

reasoning_chains.one_sentence: Incomplete evidence increases the value of reversibility.
logic: The evidence required for an irreversible choice is incomplete.
A reversible option can produce the missing evidence.
Choose the reversible option unless external authority requires otherwise.

version_notes: No Creation Accepted or human-confirmation claim is made.
